per_check.name: chip_conservation
per_check.description: stacks + pots + bets stay constant through every event of a hand (rules.md 7.9)

per_check.name: table_bankroll
per_check.description: between hands the chips on the table equal buy-ins + adjustments - cash-outs

per_check.name: event_stream
per_check.description: sequence numbers increase, the log opens with hand_started and closes with hand_ended

per_check.name: deck_integrity
per_check.description: no card is dealt twice in a hand, holes and board come from one 52-card deck (7.3)

per_check.name: button_and_blinds
per_check.description: small and big blind sit clockwise from the button, heads-up the button is the small blind (7.2)

per_check.name: turn_order
per_check.description: the first actor of every street is correct and no other seat can act (7.4)

per_check.name: legal_options
per_check.description: the offered fold/check/call/raise/all-in set matches the betting rules re-derived independently (7.5)

per_check.name: illegal_actions_rejected
per_check.description: checks facing a bet, undersized raises and raises over the stack are refused and move no chips (7.5)

per_check.name: pot_construction
per_check.description: main and side pots recomputed from the contributions match the engine, folded chips count but never win (7.6)

per_check.name: showdown_awards
per_check.description: every pot goes to the best eligible hand, splits are equal and odd chips go clockwise from the button (7.8)

per_check.name: hand_results
per_check.description: the result of a hand adds up: net per seat sums to zero and equals end stack minus start stack
